1. Finding a problem.research-gap-finder: Scans recent papers on a topic and lists open problems, contradictions, and under-explored areas
1. Finding a problem.research-question-formulator: Turns a vague interest into testable questions and hypotheses (PICO, FINER)
1. Finding a problem.novelty-checker: Checks whether an idea has already been done and finds the closest prior work
1. Finding a problem.topic-trend-analyzer: Tracks publication volume, rising keywords, and hot subfields over time

2. Literature discovery and reading.paper-search: Unified search across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, PubMed, and Crossref
2. Literature discovery and reading.citation-graph-explorer: Forward and backward citation chasing and seminal-paper detection
2. Literature discovery and reading.paper-summarizer: Structured summary covering problem, method, data, results, limitations
2. Literature discovery and reading.paper-critic: Critical reading for weak assumptions, missing baselines, and threats to validity
2. Literature discovery and reading.paper-comparison-matrix: A table comparing N papers on method, dataset, metrics, and results
2. Literature discovery and reading.math-and-equation-explainer: Step-by-step explanation of derivations and notation

3. Literature review.systematic-review-prisma: Full PRISMA workflow with search strings, screening, inclusion criteria, and flow diagram
3. Literature review.literature-review-writer: Thematic synthesis rather than paper-by-paper summaries
3. Literature review.related-work-writer: A related-work section positioned against your contribution

4. Research design and methodology.methodology-designer: Picks qualitative, quantitative, or mixed design with justification
4. Research design and methodology.experiment-planner: Variables, controls, baselines, ablations, and compute budget
4. Research design and methodology.sample-size-power-calculator: Power analysis and sample size justification
4. Research design and methodology.survey-questionnaire-designer: Likert scales, validity checks, and pilot plan
4. Research design and methodology.dataset-finder: Locates datasets on Hugging Face, Kaggle, UCI, and Papers with Code
4. Research design and methodology.ethics-irb-drafter: Ethics application, consent forms, and data management plan

5. Experiments and analysis.paper-to-code-reproducer: Implements a paper's method from the PDF
5. Experiments and analysis.statistical-test-selector: Picks the right test, runs it, and reports in APA style
5. Experiments and analysis.results-interpreter: Turns raw numbers into findings, with honest caveats
5. Experiments and analysis.ablation-study-designer: Decides which components to remove and how to report it
5. Experiments and analysis.qualitative-coding-assistant: Thematic coding of interviews and transcripts
5. Experiments and analysis.experiment-logger: Lab notebook that tracks runs, configs, and decisions

6. Writing.paper-outline-generator: IMRaD outline adapted to the target venue
6. Writing.introduction-writer: Context, gap, contribution, and outline flow
6. Writing.academic-tone-editor: Fixes clarity, hedging, and concision, and removes AI-sounding prose
6. Writing.latex-paper-formatter: Converts drafts to IEEE, ACM, Springer, NeurIPS, or ACL templates
6. Writing.thesis-chapter-writer: Long-form chapters with consistent cross-chapter terminology
6. Writing.limitations-and-future-work-writer: The section people usually write poorly

7. Figures and tables.publication-figure-maker: matplotlib and TikZ plots at journal quality
7. Figures and tables.latex-table-generator: Converts CSV to booktabs tables with best results bolded

8. Citations and integrity.citation-verifier: Confirms every reference exists and supports the claim (catches hallucinated citations)
8. Citations and integrity.bibtex-manager: Cleans, deduplicates, and fixes BibTeX entries
8. Citations and integrity.citation-style-converter: Converts between APA, IEEE, Vancouver, and Harvard
8. Citations and integrity.plagiarism-and-paraphrase-checker: Flags text that is too close to its source
8. Citations and integrity.reproducibility-checklist: Fills in NeurIPS or ML reproducibility checklists

9. Submission and peer review.venue-recommender: Matches a paper to journals and conferences by scope, impact, and deadline
9. Submission and peer review.camera-ready-checker: Page limits, anonymization, formatting, and metadata

10. Funding and career.grant-proposal-writer: Aims, significance, budget, and timeline (including Indian schemes such as DST, SERB, and UGC)
10. Funding and career.sop-and-research-statement-writer: Statement of purpose and research statement
10. Funding and career.supervisor-finder: Finds professors by research fit and drafts a cold email

11. Dissemination.viva-defense-prep: Likely examiner questions and model answers

12. Orchestrators.research-scholar-orchestrator: Master skill that routes a request to the right skills in sequence
12. Orchestrators.idea-to-paper-pipeline: Chains topic, gap, review, method, draft, and self-review
12. Orchestrators.weekly-paper-digest: Scheduled digest of new papers in your area
12. Orchestrators.research-progress-tracker: Milestones, supervisor meeting notes, and next actions
